job.title: Advanced SerDes & Analog/Mixed-Signal IC Design Intern – Summer 2027
job.descriptionText:
Why join Upscale, Inc.

Upscale, Inc., is building the high-performance infrastructure powering the next generation of artificial intelligence. Backed by over $500M in funding and rapid global adoption, we are scaling systems designed for the world’s most demanding AI workloads.

We focus on first-principles engineering across silicon, systems, and networking—where performance, scale, and execution are critical. Our team is talent-dense and high-performing. We value ownership, technical rigor, and speed, and we offer the opportunity to work on foundational problems with immediate, real-world impact.

If you’re looking to do high-impact work, move fast, and help define the infrastructure behind the future of AI—Upscale is where you can produce meaningful work at the frontier—and operate at a high standard.

About the Role

Upscale AI is developing next-generation high-speed connectivity solutions for AI infrastructure and data centers. We are looking for highly motivated summer interns to work alongside our experienced engineering team on advanced SerDes and analog/mixed-signal integrated circuit design.

This internship offers hands-on opportunities to explore challenging problems at the intersection of high-speed circuit design, digital signal processing, and AI-driven engineering methodologies. Depending on your background and interests, you may contribute to one or more of the following areas:

- High-Speed ADC Design and Modeling: Research and develop high-performance ADC architectures for next-generation SerDes receivers, including sampling architectures, time-interleaved ADCs, calibration techniques, and optimization of speed, resolution, power, and linearity.
- Foundation IP Development: Contribute to the design, modeling, characterization, and optimization of foundation analog/mixed-signal IP blocks that enable next-generation SerDes, including clocking, data conversion, calibration, and related circuit building blocks.
- AI-Driven Circuit Design: Develop and apply AI/ML techniques to accelerate circuit design, optimization, modeling, and verification. Explore automated design-space exploration, intelligent parameter optimization, surrogate modeling, and AI-assisted engineering workflows.
- Ultra-Low-Jitter PLL Design and Modeling: Explore advanced PLL architectures for high-speed communication systems, including low-jitter clock generation, digitally intensive PLL architecture and design. Investigate phase-noise performance, jitter optimization, and high-precision modeling of the PLL in the digital domain.

What You’ll Do

- Collaborate with experienced engineers to investigate challenging circuit and system-level design problems.
- Develop analytical models, behavioral simulations, and circuit-level simulations to evaluate new architectures and design approaches.
- Build scripts and tools to automate simulation, data analysis, optimization, and design workflows.
- Explore novel algorithms and circuit techniques to improve performance, power efficiency, robustness, and design productivity.
- Present technical findings, simulation results, and design recommendations to the engineering team.
- Where appropriate, contribute to circuit implementation, verification, characterization, or silicon measurement activities.

Qualifications:

- Currently pursuing an M.S. or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
- Strong fundamentals in analog and mixed-signal circuit design, communication systems, signal processing, or related areas.
- Experience with circuit simulation, numerical analysis, or engineering computation.
- Proficiency in Python, MATLAB, or similar tools for modeling, automation, and data analysis.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently investigate technical challenges.

Preferred Qualifications

- Coursework, research, or project experience in one or more of the following:
  - AI/ML applications in EDA, circuit design, or engineering optimization.
  - High-speed ADCs, data converters, or receiver architectures.
  - PLLs, clock generation, phase noise, jitter analysis, or DTC/TDC-based digital PLLs.
  - High-speed SerDes, wireline transceivers, or high-speed communication systems.
  - Analog/mixed-signal foundation IP development and circuit optimization.

- Familiarity with SPICE-based circuit simulators, MATLAB/Python modeling, RTL, or digital signal processing.
- Experience with optimization algorithms, machine learning, behavioral modeling, or automated verification.
- A strong track record of research, technical projects, publications, or hands-on implementation.

What You’ll Gain

- Work on advanced connectivity technologies for AI data center infrastructure.
- Gain exposure to real-world circuit design challenges at the intersection of architecture, algorithms, and transistor-level implementation.
- Learn from experienced engineers developing next-generation high-speed analog and mixed-signal IP.
- Own a well-defined technical project with measurable engineering outcomes and opportunities to present your work.

We welcome candidates who are curious, technically ambitious, and eager to turn innovative ideas into practical silicon solutions.

Where you fall within that range depends on your experience, skills, and impact—we benchmark against internal levels to keep things fair and consistent.

Upscale, Inc., is building a team that reflects a wide range of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences. We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or veteran status.

- Helping develop and following best practices, security and engineering standards.

- Leverage AI tools to assist in productivity, testing, and automation

- A passion for technology, reverse engineering and writing code to create solutions and fix problems.  

- A collaborative attitude and the ability to clearly articulate thoughts and processes with both verbal and written communication in one-on-one and group settings. 

- Experience with Windows and Linux systems, containers and databases. 

- Experience with source code, build, deploy, orchestration and configuration management tools. 

- Experience in writing code and scripts in at least one high-level programming language. 

- An eye to identify and a desire to resolve insufficiencies and manual activities via automation. 

- Familiarity with public cloud architecture and technologies, preferably AWS. 

- Familiarity with Agile concepts and processes (Scrum and Kanban). 

- An interest in building and continuously improving secure and resilient applications at scale.

- An interest in gathering data and measuring the progress on what makes applications perform.

- Familiarity with AI tools that assist in producing, testing, and automating tasks in software development and deployment.

Stratolaunch accelerates the development of next-generation aerospace and defense technologies through reusable hypersonic flight testing. Our autonomous, air-launched Talon-A vehicles provide access to operationally realistic flight environments at speeds exceeding Mach 5, delivering critical data that helps customers validate system performance and advance technologies toward deployment. Our team brings together expertise in engineering, manufacturing, and flight operations to solve complex challenges and advance capabilities essential to national security.

Application window closes 11/7/26

Stratolaunch is seeking a detail-orientated and driven Supply Chain Intern to support our operations team. This role offers hands-on experience in a fast-paced environment, with exposure to procurement, aircraft parts logistics, inventory control, and vendor coordination critical to maintaining operational readiness.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

Procurement

- Assist with creating and processing purchase requisitions and purchase orders for production materials, components, tooling, and indirect supplies.
- Support buyers in obtaining supplier quotes, confirming lead times, and tracking order status.
- Help maintain accurate purchasing records, pricing information, and supplier documentation within the ERP system.
- Review open purchase orders and help identify potential material shortages, late deliveries, and other supply risks.
- Assist with expediting critical materials to support production schedules and customer commitments.

Shipping and Receiving

- Support receiving activities by verifying incoming materials against purchase orders, packing slips, certifications, and inspection requirements.
- Assist with labeling, documenting, and routing received materials to inspection, stock, production, or quarantine areas.
- Help prepare domestic and international shipments, including packaging, shipping documentation, carrier coordination, and tracking.
- Maintain accurate shipping and receiving records in accordance with company procedures and aerospace quality requirements.
- Assist with investigating shipping discrepancies, damaged goods, incorrect quantities, and missing documentation.

Supplier Management

- Support supplier communication regarding order acknowledgments, delivery schedules, quality documentation, and corrective actions.
- Assist in maintaining supplier performance data, including on-time delivery, quality performance, lead times, and responsiveness.
- Help organize supplier records, certifications, approvals, and compliance documentation.
- Participate in supplier review meetings and assist with follow-up actions as assigned.
- Support efforts to identify alternate suppliers and mitigate supply-chain risks.

Inventory Control

- Assist with cycle counts, physical inventory activities, and reconciliation of inventory variances.
- Help maintain accurate inventory records, location data, and material traceability in the ERP system.
- Monitor inventory levels and support replenishment planning for critical materials and consumables.
- Assist with identifying excess, obsolete, damaged, or slow-moving inventory.
- Support material movement and warehouse organization to improve inventory accuracy and operational efficiency.

QUALIFICATIONS

- Currently pursuing a degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Management, Operations Management, Logistics, or related field.

job.descriptionText:
Stanley Black & Decker - UX/UI Design Intern

Valley City, Ohio

Position Summary

Stanley Black & Decker is seeking a motivated, curious, and thoughtful UX/UI Design Intern to join our design team and contribute to the development of user experiences for physical products across our portfolio of trusted brands.

With iconic brands such as DEWALT, CRAFTSMAN, STANLEY, BLACK+DECKER, and Cub Cadet. Stanley Black & Decker designs products that professionals, tradespeople, and consumers rely on every day. This internship offers an opportunity to work alongside experienced designers, engineers, and cross-functional partners to understand how user-centered design is applied to real-world products—from human-machine interfaces and controls to product interfaces.

This role is ideal for a developing designer who wants to apply UX/UI principles beyond traditional digital screens and into the physical world. The intern will support research, ideation, interaction design, prototyping, documentation, and design communication throughout the product development process, while gaining exposure to the technical, business, and manufacturing realities that shape great product experiences.

The ideal candidate is interested in understanding why a design works, not simply how it looks. They are comfortable asking thoughtful questions, exploring multiple solutions, receiving feedback, and clearly communicating their design thinking.

Key Responsibilities

- Support UX/UI design activities for product interfaces, including human-machine interfaces (HMI), displays, and controls.
- Assist with user research, competitive analysis, and synthesis of findings to identify design opportunities and inform product decisions.
- Create wireframes, user flows, interface concepts, prototypes, and visual design explorations that communicate experience direction clearly and effectively.
- Help translate complex user, technical, and business requirements into clear, intuitive, and usable experiences.
- Participate in design reviews and communicate design rationale to designers, engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders.
- Iterate on concepts based on feedback, usability insights, technical constraints, and evolving product requirements.
- Support the creation and maintenance of design standards, specifications, and supporting documentation to enable consistency across product experiences.
- Collaborate with industrial design, engineering, product management, and other cross-functional teams throughout the development process.
- Help prepare presentations and communication materials used to explain design concepts, recommendations, and decisions.
- Contribute to broader design initiatives and special projects as opportunities arise.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for a candidate who demonstrates strong potential in the following areas:

- Strong Communication: Communicates ideas, questions, progress, and challenges clearly with teammates and cross-functional partners.
- Initiative: Takes ownership of assigned work, moves tasks forward proactively, and knows when to seek clarification or additional direction.
- Coachability: Welcomes feedback, applies it thoughtfully, and demonstrates a genuine willingness to learn and improve.
- Problem-Solving Mindset: Looks beyond the surface of a design challenge, considers user needs and real-world constraints, and can explain the reasoning behind design decisions.

Qualifications

- Currently pursuing a degree in UX/UI Design, Interaction Design, Industrial Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Human Factors, or a related field.
- Coursework or project experience in user experience, interaction design, product design, interface design, or related disciplines.
- Familiarity with design and prototyping tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, or comparable software.
- Ability to create and communicate basic wireframes, flows, prototypes, and interface concepts.
- Strong visual, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
- Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.
- A portfolio demonstrating design thinking, problem-solving, and process is preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

- Exposure to physical product interfaces, embedded systems, or HMI design through coursework, projects, or internships.
- Familiarity with usability testing, design systems, accessibility principles, or interaction prototyping.
- Interest in designing for products used in professional, industrial, outdoor, or consumer environments.

What You Will Learn

Through this internship, you will gain practical experience in:

- Designing experiences for real-world products and users.
- Applying UX principles within physical product and HMI development.
- Working within technical, business, and manufacturing constraints.
- Collaborating with industrial designers, engineers, and product teams.
- Developing and communicating design rationale to cross-functional stakeholders.
- Taking a design from early concept through refinement and implementation.
- Understanding how design standards and systems create consistency across a broader product portfolio.

Why Join Stanley Black & Decker

At Stanley Black & Decker, you will have the opportunity to contribute to products backed by some of the most recognized and trusted brands in the world. You will work in a collaborative environment where design, engineering, and business teams come together to solve real problems for real users.

This internship is designed to provide meaningful, hands-on experience—not only in creating interface concepts, but in understanding how thoughtful design decisions are shaped by user needs, technical feasibility, product strategy, and manufacturing realities. You will be supported by experienced professionals and gain exposure to the end-to-end product development process within a global organization.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is curious, thoughtful, collaborative, and eager to learn. They do not need to know everything coming into the internship. More important is their ability to ask strong questions, think critically about design problems, respond constructively to feedback, and take ownership of their work.

This is an opportunity for a developing designer to build strong fundamentals while applying UX/UI principles to physical products that people use in the real world.
